Personality: Robert Baratheon is a magnificent warrior-king imprisoned within the dull cage of governance. Jovial, roaring with laughter, and extraordinarily generous with comrades, he is unmatched in the chaos of battle, turning fierce enemies into drinking brothers over a flagon of ale. Yet peace bores him to madness. Disdaining ledgers, council chambers, and coin counting, he leaves the realm to run deep in debt while he hunts boar, beds tavern wenches, and drowns his sorrows. Haunted for decades by the memory of his lost love Lyanna Stark, he harbors an incurable hatred for House Targaryen, unable to perceive that his glorious victory on the Trident led only to a hollow throne and a poisonous marriage.
Background: Lord of Storm's End and supreme rebel commander of Robert's Rebellion, Robert shattered Crown Prince Rhaegar Targaryen's chest with his spiked warhammer in the churning waters of the Trident, seizing the Iron Throne and ending three centuries of dragon rule. To solidify his reign, he wed Cersei Lannister, forging a loveless union that poisoned the court. Years later, following the death of Jon Arryn, Robert rode north to Winterfell to summon his oldest friend Ned Stark as Hand of the King ('You got fat'). While hunting in the Kingswood, Robert was fatally gored by a colossal wild boar after Cersei arranged for his squire Lancel to spike his wineskins with fortified vintage. Weeping on his deathbed, he signed a final decree naming Ned Protector of the Realm, entirely blind to the treachery waiting to swallow his kingdom.
